x-mcp-tools.name: open_system_search
x-mcp-tools.title: 打开手机系统搜索
x-mcp-tools.description: Open iOS System Search for an installed app. Returns its actual after-image; inspect it (see server instructions), then type the app name without Return and select its installed icon. On uncertain input, query the original command instead of repeating.

image_format.description: Compact PNG for Spotlight focus or the original JPEG. Omit for the tool's default.

x-mcp-tools.name: type_text_in_field
x-mcp-tools.title: 在已聚焦的输入框输入文字
x-mcp-tools.description: Type printable ASCII into the focused field, clearing first by default. Set clear_before_input=false only to append. For in-app search use submit=enter; omit it for app discovery or drafts. T6 final sends/payments must not be submitted. Inspect the returned image (see server instructions). Unknown input: query the original command.

x-mcp-tools.name: get_control_guide
x-mcp-tools.title: 读取手机操作步骤指南
x-mcp-tools.description: Read detailed guidance for the selected workflow when needed. Returns instructions only; does not inspect the phone or grant readiness. T6 final-step handoff and hidden-screen rules apply.

x-mcp-tools.name: move_mouse_to
x-mcp-tools.title: 绝对定位手机鼠标
x-mcp-tools.description: Move without clicking to an original-image pixel target using its exact source and geometry. Use before scrolling or for T6 final-step handoff. Inspect the returned image, not metadata (see server instructions); only then describe where the pointer is. Unknown input: query the original command.

settle_ms.description: Minimum actual capture gap after phone board acknowledgement; UI effect still requires inspecting the image.

x-mcp-tools.name: get_mouse_state
x-mcp-tools.title: 手机鼠标连接状态
x-mcp-tools.description: Check the selected phone’s current input authorization and capabilities when unknown. Returns readiness, not permission to bypass missing authorization. Do not call this before Stop.

x-mcp-tools.name: scroll_mouse
x-mcp-tools.title: 滚动手机鼠标滚轮
x-mcp-tools.description: Scroll the visible content with bounded signed wheel steps. Use the current actual image to place the pointer in that content first. Inspect the returned image to determine movement and direction (see server instructions). Unknown input: query the original command.

wait_ms.description: Optional total action and image budget. Omit for the default 2000 ms action wait and independent confirmed-scroll image window.

settle_ms.description: Minimum actual capture gap after phone board acknowledgement; UI effect still requires inspecting the image.

x-mcp-tools.name: click_at
x-mcp-tools.title: 移动并点击后观察手机
x-mcp-tools.description: T6: For irreversible final payments, orders, sends, deletions, subscription cancellations or transfers, do not call click_at. Use move_mouse_to, inspect its actual after-image, then name the button and ask the user to tap it themselves. No Return or other input may substitute; this is soft guidance, not code enforcement or C124 approval. For ordinary targets, pass original-image pixel x/y, device_id, source_frame_id, dimensions, orientation and unchanged source_point_proof when supplied. Inspect the returned image, not metadata (see server instructions). Unknown input: query the original command; never replay.

source_frame_id.description: Exact reviewed JPEG frame ID for a device reporting action_geometry_ready. Requires device_id.

source_point_proof.description: Exact proof from this same released visual read. Requires device_id and source_frame_id. Ordinary explicit pixel-coordinate clicks do not require crops. If omitted, the same frame is looked up automatically; never invent or modify the proof.

wait_ms.description: Optional total budget for input and after-image. Omit for the default independent paired after-image window.

x-mcp-tools.name: get_mouse_result
x-mcp-tools.title: 读取手机鼠标操作结果
x-mcp-tools.description: Recover an original command without repeating input. Use command_id alone, or the original click_at_idempotency_key with device_id if IDs were lost. Pending, missing and uncertain results do not authorize replay. include_after_screen requests a read-only after-image when supported; inspect actual image blocks, not metadata (see server instructions). Use after_command_min_gap_ms only as its parameter describes.

image_format.description: Compact PNG for Spotlight focus or the original JPEG. Omit for the tool's default.

command_id.description: Original command ID. When provided, omit device_id and click_at_idempotency_key.

device_id.description: Only with click_at_idempotency_key for receipt lookup without an image. Omit when using command_id.

after_command_min_gap_ms.description: Only with include_after_screen and the original confirmed click, open_system_search or type_text_in_field command ID. Round the previous after_command.lower_gap_ms up to require a newer capture, within 0–5000 ms. The read-only observation waits up to 5000 ms and returns images strictly younger than 2000 ms; it never resubmits input.

x-mcp-tools.name: drag_at
x-mcp-tools.title: 按住并拖拽后观察手机
x-mcp-tools.description: Drag a visible object or handle between original-image pixel endpoints using the exact source and geometry. Normally omit duration_ms for 350 ms; deliberate durations are 120–1000 ms. No calibration or relative fallback. Inspect the returned image (see server instructions). Unknown input: query the original command.

from_x.description: Start x in original image pixels. Convert a normalized fraction as x*(image_width-1).

from_y.description: Start y in original image pixels. Convert a normalized fraction as y*(image_height-1).

to_x.description: End x in original image pixels; use the same coordinate space as from_x.

to_y.description: End y in original image pixels; use the same coordinate space as from_y.

duration_ms.description: Normally omit for the default 350 ms. When deliberately needed, choose 120–1000 ms.

wait_ms.description: Optional total action and image budget. Omit for the default 6000 ms action wait and independent confirmed-drag image window.

x-mcp-tools.name: stop_mouse
x-mcp-tools.title: 停止手机鼠标控制
x-mcp-tools.description: Stop input immediately without a readiness lookup. Omit device_id to stop all your devices, or select one owned device. Returns cloud stop state; physical release is separately confirmed. Screen sharing may continue. Never automatically re-enable.

x-mcp-tools.name: read_screen
x-mcp-tools.title: 立即读取手机画面
x-mcp-tools.description: Inspect actual image blocks in content_items or MCP content; structuredContent metadata is not a visible image. If needed display image(block) with host image support. Read the current shared screen when no usable action image exists. Returns actual image blocks and their source/geometry. Inspect the returned image, not metadata (see server instructions). Reuse action after-images for subsequent decisions; never act on unavailable pixels.

include_read_timing.description: Opt in to bounded database timing and server frame-age timestamps for diagnostics. These precede response serialization and do not measure host image receipt.

if_unchanged_since.description: An earlier actual image_ref still visible in this conversation.

after_command_min_gap_ms.description: Require actual capture strictly after the confirmed command phone timestamp plus this delay; requires after_command_id.

x-mcp-tools.name: create_pairing_code
x-mcp-tools.title: 生成手机配对码
x-mcp-tools.description: Create a short-lived code for pairing the SaySo phone app with your private service. Enter it in SaySo. This does not pair the C124 accessory or authorize control.

x-mcp-tools.name: list_devices
x-mcp-tools.title: 查看我的共享设备
x-mcp-tools.description: List your phones and active sharing sessions. Returns readiness metadata, not an image or credentials.

x-mcp-tools.name: stop_session
x-mcp-tools.title: 停止共享会话并清图
x-mcp-tools.description: Stop sharing sessions and clear their cloud screen data without a readiness lookup. Omit bridge_session_id to stop all your ongoing sessions, or select one owned session. Returns stopped and failed session IDs. iOS screen-sharing termination must be confirmed separately; chat images cannot be erased here.

x-mcp-tools.name: revoke_device
x-mcp-tools.title: 撤销手机配对
x-mcp-tools.description: Revoke the selected owned device, stop its cloud session and remove its associated cloud data. Requires device_id. Existing chat content is unaffected.

Preserve mimeType/mime_type and Base64 data. Stop if the host cannot display the image.

The widget prefetches fixture pixels and probes the host's model-context/sampling capabilities. It never reads a phone or controls a device. It is not evidence that the existing Live client meets a latency target.

x-mcp-tools.name: read_benchmark_frame

Optional image_format and response_layout select the carrier. With match_payload_size=true, the full PNG has the same image bytes count as the corresponding JPEG without changing pixels. Optional preview=true returns a 240x427 PNG with truthful native-size metadata. Analyze only those pixels and answer the requested brief visual task. This is not an iPhone screenshot or real-time screen capture; it never calls a model, sends a device command, or writes product data. Preserve mimeType/mime_type and Base64 data. Stop if the host cannot display the image.

match_payload_size.description: Full-size only. Match PNG image bytes to the corresponding JPEG length without modifying pixel data.
